headlines.title: 45% Upside for Constellation Energy? Barclays Thinks So, and Here’s How
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysBarclays raised its Constellation Energy price target to $371 from $345 on Nov. 19, 45% above the stock, which trades 33% below its December 2025 high.

headlines.title: Constellation Energy Sinks 10% in a Week as AI Stocks Slide, Giving Back Its Earnings Jump. Time to Buy?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy fell 10% in the past week as AI stocks sold off, giving back most of its jump on a third-quarter beat and guidance raise. NuScale, Oklo and Cameco fell even more, and most of the week’s analyst news on Constellation was higher price targets.

headlines.title: Constellation Energy (CEG) Following Its Earnings Beat And Guidance Hike Looks Cheap Versus Fair Value
headlines.summary: Constellation Energy (CEG) is back in focus after its third quarter report, with sales of US$9.55b and net income of US$1.84b, as well as raised full year adjusted operating earnings guidance. Constellation Energy’s third quarter beat and guidance hike came against a weaker tape, with the share price down 28.26% year to date and the latest close at US$262.74, even though the 3 year total shareholder return is up 117.14%.

headlines.title: Capital Group Div Value (CGDV) Adds Home Depot and Constellation on Nov. 17
headlines.summary: The $39.13 billion fund bought $237.5 million of Home Depot and $175.7 million of Constellation Energy, both new positions, while trimming Cisco by $185.4 million.

description: Constellation Energy Corporation produces and sells energy products and services in the United States. The company operates through five segments: Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, New York, ERCOT, and Other Power Regions. It offers electricity, natural gas, energy-related products, and sustainable solutions. The company has approximately 31,676 megawatts of generating capacity consisting of nuclear, wind, solar, natural gas, and hydroelectric assets. It serves distribution utilities, municipalities, cooperatives, and commercial, industrial, public sector, and residential customers. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland.
